_comment: Grandfathered apps/desktop complexity violations, keyed PER VIOLATION (rule, file, message) rather than per file: ESLint's flat config can only ever relax a whole FILE, and a per-file list lets every other function in that file drift unnoticed. Regenerate with `node scripts/check-complexity.mjs --update` ONLY to record a deliberate, reviewed addition — never to turn a red gate green. Shrink this list; do not grow it.
